name: Suzuki Shinobu
source:
A 1st year middle schooler.
He's selfish, but smart and athletic. A cool child prodigy.
He's the son of a rich family and even has his own personal butler.
He realized he's in love with [url=/c51799]Chihiro[/url] so he enrolled into the basketball club in order to chase after her.
